findings.title: Codebase build is broken: action-inbox Server Actions are not async, poisoning /admin/*, /workshop, /privacy, /security, /access-required
findings.precondition: Next.js 16 / React 19 dev server or production build at HEAD b2a934919
findings.expected_behavior: `bun run build` exits 0; /workshop and /admin/* render the authenticated dashboard.
findings.actual_behavior: `bun run build` exits 1 with 'Server Actions must be async functions' for snoozeActionItem, resolveActionItem, dismissActionItem. Dev server returns HTTP 500 for /workshop, /admin, /admin/today, /privacy, /security, /access-required.
findings.call_flow_trace: src/app/admin/today/page.tsx:1 -> @/components/admin/AdminActionInbox -> @/lib/admin/action-inbox-actions. Next.js 16 webpack bundles the entire src/app/** route tree for dev HMR, so the broken module graph cascades.
findings.user_business_impact: No deployment is possible. Every workshop/admin route is unusable. Pre-recruiting readiness is zero.
findings.root_cause: Three 'use server' exports declared as non-async functions returning Promise<T>. Next.js 16 (React 19 'use server' contract) requires async function declarations for server action exports.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Add `async` keyword to the three exported function declarations. Bodies already use `await` via the inner async `runActionInboxMutation` helper; the wrappers just need to be async to satisfy the contract.
findings.acceptance_evidence: `bun run build` exits 0; `curl /workshop` and `/admin` return 200.

findings.title: Closed-beta request-access form POSTs to a non-existent handler (/contact has no route.ts; force-static)
findings.precondition: Visitor on /signup (closed-beta gate rendered because CLOSED_BETA_ACCESS_ENABLED is false or the visitor lacks allowlist entry)
findings.expected_behavior: Beta-request is captured server-side; visitor sees a confirmation; founder sees the lead in /admin/support or the beta allowlist admin.
findings.actual_behavior: /contact has only page.tsx with `export const dynamic = 'force-static'` and no route.ts. A POST against a static Next.js page returns 405 (or, on some configs, a 500/static-render fallback). The lead is lost.
findings.call_flow_trace: ClosedBetaGate renders <form action='/contact' method='post'> with hidden intent=beta-request. /contact is force-static, no POST handler.
findings.user_business_impact: The only 'request access' CTA on the closed-beta gate is a dead end. Pre-recruiting lead capture is broken at the source. Visitors see an error and bounce.
findings.founder_rescue_cost_minutes: every beta request requires manual founder outreach because no lead is captured
findings.root_cause: Closed-beta gate posts to a route that the contact page cannot serve. The component's own JSDoc acknowledges 'there is no contact server action in src/lib/landing/' and chose a plain HTML form, but the chosen target does not accept POST.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Either (a) add src/app/contact/route.ts that accepts POST and persists the beta-request to D1, or (b) replace the form with the same mailto-builder pattern used by ContactForm, or (c) point the form at a new /api/signup/beta-request handler.
findings.acceptance_evidence: POST /contact (or new endpoint) returns 200/302 with a confirmation; source inspection shows the handler; manual submit succeeds.
duplicate_symptoms_absorbed: UX-SIGNUP-001 (signup is a dead-end - same root cause)

findings.title: Three parallel landing CTA systems with three different copy/destination conventions; LandingHeader drops the intent param on secondary marketing pages
findings.severity_adjustment_note: Downgraded Critical -> High after second-pass adversarial challenge: LandingHeader does NOT render on / (PublicPageShell renders children directly when isHomePage=true), so the intent-loss defect affects only secondary marketing pages (/privacy, /security, /features, /terms), not the homepage hero. The three-systems inconsistency still stands as High because it fragments lead-routing analytics and risks future drift.
findings.precondition: Visitor scans hero on / or nav on a secondary marketing page (/privacy, /security, /features, /terms) or final CTA.
reproducible_steps: Read src/components/landing/LandingHeader.tsx:115 (header CTA href='/contact' with no intent param).
Read src/app/page.tsx:20 (passes isHomePage=true, so / does not render LandingHeader).
findings.expected_behavior: One CTA component, one destination, one intent vocabulary across hero/nav/final-cta/header.
findings.actual_behavior: Three CTA systems in parallel: landing-v3 hero uses 'Book a walkthrough' + intent=walkthrough; the shared LandingCTAs uses 'Start with an estimate' + intent=started; LandingHeader (which renders only on secondary marketing pages, NOT on /) drops the intent entirely. ContactForm.tsx:58-62 uses the intent param to preselect the inquiry dropdown, so secondary-page header-origin traffic lands on a mis-segmented generic form. The homepage hero is unaffected by the header issue but still inconsistent with LandingCTAs.
findings.user_business_impact: Conversion path is inconsistent across surfaces; lead-routing signal is lost for secondary-page header traffic; A/B and conversion analytics are noisy.
findings.founder_rescue_cost_minutes: founder cannot attribute signup intent to a CTA on secondary-page traffic
findings.root_cause: landing-v3 was layered on top of the older landing/ primitives without consolidating CTA constants; LandingHeader was never updated to pass intent.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Minimum safe fix: add ?intent=walkthrough to LandingHeader.tsx:115 (no regression). Full fix: pick one CTA component (recommend LandingCTAs as the shared primitive), one destination, one intent vocabulary. Hero copy unification is a deliberate brand decision and out of scope for the minimum fix.
findings.acceptance_evidence: LandingHeader passes an intent param; ContactForm receives the right preselected dropdown for header-origin traffic.

findings.title: A/B experiment 'hero-cta-copy' declared but no variant B exists; ABExperimentProvider ignores the variant prop
findings.severity_adjustment_note: Downgraded High -> Medium after second-pass adversarial challenge: the variant prop is in deps but never read; however the component DOES fire trackExperimentView(experimentId) once consent is granted (ABExperimentProvider.tsx:22-25), so analytics events ARE emitted, just undifferentiated. Source path also corrected: src/components/landing/ABExperimentProvider.tsx (NOT landing-v3/, which does not exist).
findings.precondition: src/app/page.tsx wraps the page in <ABExperimentProvider experimentId='hero-cta-copy' variant='A'>.
reproducible_steps: Read src/components/landing/ABExperimentProvider.tsx:13-29 (variant prop is in deps but never read; trackExperimentView is called with experimentId only).
grep 'hero-cta-copy' src/ - only trackConversion calls in LandingHeader.tsx:104,117,127, no variant B copy anywhere.
findings.expected_behavior: Either variants are implemented and assigned, or no experiment is declared.
findings.actual_behavior: Variant prop is ignored; only variant A copy exists; experiment_view events fire labeled 'A' implicitly (undifferentiated).
findings.user_business_impact: CTA copy decisions cannot be data-driven; analytics noise (events fire but cannot be split by variant).
findings.root_cause: ABExperimentProvider was scaffolded but variant assignment was never implemented.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Either implement variant assignment in ABExperimentProvider (cookie- or random-based) and add a variant B copy, or remove the wrapper (safe: it only renders children plus a one-shot analytics effect).
findings.acceptance_evidence: Either variants are assigned at runtime, or the wrapper is removed and analytics no longer fire experiment_view.

findings.title: First-estimate checklist 'Publish' step is hardcoded to not_available for every user on every session
findings.precondition: Authenticated user on /workshop with an active activation checklist.
reproducible_steps: Inspect the final 'Publish when ready' row.
findings.expected_behavior: Either the publish step is wired to actual milestone detection, or it is hidden when not reachable.
findings.actual_behavior: src/lib/onboarding/first-estimate-checklist.ts:42 hardcodes `{ id: 'publish', label: 'Publish when ready', href: '/workshop/publisher', status: 'not_available' }`. FirstEstimateChecklist.tsx:42 appends ' (not available)' and shows a 'Some checklist steps are not available yet. Continue with the available steps, or contact support' notice at :48-52 for every user, every session.
findings.user_business_impact: First-estimate journey's terminal 'publish' milestone is unreachable from the checklist, undercutting the activation funnel at exactly the conversion moment. New users see a permanently-broken final step.
findings.founder_rescue_cost_minutes: every new user asks 'why is publish not available'
findings.root_cause: Checklist definition hardcodes status rather than deriving it from a publish-milestone predicate.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Either wire publish-milestone detection (publish becomes 'available' once an estimate has rows and a contractor profile), or hide the row when not_available instead of always showing it.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Checklist either hides the publish row when not reachable or shows it as actionable when the predicate is satisfied.

findings.title: Magic-link error states collapse to one undifferentiated 'callback_exchange_failed' message

reproducible_steps: Tap it twice (already-used), or wait past expiry, or open on a different browser/device.

findings.title: ContactForm is client-side mailto only; no server persistence, rate-limit, or duplicate-submission guard
findings.precondition: Visitor on /contact submits the form.
findings.expected_behavior: Lead is persisted server-side; founder can see it in /admin/support.
findings.actual_behavior: src/components/landing/ContactForm.tsx:73-84 calls window.open(nextMailtoLink, '_self'). No server persistence, no rate-limit, no duplicate-submission guard.
findings.user_business_impact: Mobile users without a configured mail client get a dead button; lead-gen attribution is impossible (founder cannot see submissions).
findings.founder_rescue_cost_minutes: founder never sees the lead unless they reply via their own inbox
findings.root_cause: mailto was chosen as the primary path instead of a fallback.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Persist the submission to D1 via the existing admin support inbox (src/lib/admin/support-attention-repository.ts); treat mailto as a fallback.

findings.title: Landing hero uses generic SaaS copy; missing PH AEC domain vocabulary present on /pricing

findings.title: Guided sample (fastest PH-native activation path) is the least-promoted of three first-project cards

reproducible_steps: Observe the three cards: Blank / Template / Guided sample.

findings.title: Public proposal password lockout omits Retry-After; no countdown or auto-recovery
findings.precondition: Recipient enters the wrong proposal password 5+ times.
findings.expected_behavior: Lockout shows minutes-remaining (parsed from the route's Retry-After header); auto-recovers on timer expiry.
findings.actual_behavior: src/components/share/ProjectPublicationPasswordForm.tsx:36-47 maps HTTP 429 to 'locked' and shows 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.' (:57-58) but does not surface the Retry-After value; no countdown; lockout is permanent until reload.
findings.user_business_impact: Locked-out recipient has no idea when to retry; mobile recipients likely abandon.
findings.root_cause: Lockout handler does not parse the response Retry-After header.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Parse Retry-After on 429 and render minutes-remaining; auto-re-enable the form on timer expiry.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Lockout copy shows a countdown; form auto-recovers.

findings.title: Optional: future runtime regression coverage for the action-inbox async contract
findings.precondition: After UX-BUILD-001 is fixed.
findings.expected_behavior: A pre-commit or CI check rejects non-async 'use server' exports before merge.
findings.actual_behavior: No such guard exists; the break merged on 2026-07-16 and persisted for 3 days across multiple plan packs without detection.
findings.user_business_impact: Future Server Action contract violations could break the build again.
findings.root_cause: No static guard for the 'use server' async contract.
findings.smallest_coherent_fix: Optional: add a lint rule or simple grep-based check to CI that rejects `export function <name>` in a file starting with `'use server'` unless the declaration is `async`.
findings.acceptance_evidence: CI rejects a deliberately-reintroduced non-async 'use server' export.
